run_finetune_p: run the GeM p exponent finetuning script for a MultiGrain model on ImageNet
run_training_step: run a training step that computes cross-entropy loss and updates the pooling exponent p
run_validation_step: run a validation step that evaluates cross-entropy loss and top-1/top-5 accuracy
run_loop: run a training or validation loop over a DataLoader with metric tracking and logging
run_checkpoint_resume: resume a MultiGrain model from a saved checkpoint file or folder
